mapper.select: SELECT l1.level_root_id AS root_id, l2.level_name AS root_name, l3.id AS level_id, l3.level_name FROM ( SELECT DISTINCT mpr.level_root_id, mpr.level_id FROM org_member_user_rel mur LEFT JOIN org_member_post_rel mpr ON mur.member_id = mpr.member_id WHERE mur.user_id = #{userId} ) l1 LEFT JOIN org_level l2 ON l1.level_root_id = l2.id LEFT JOIN org_level l3 ON l1.level_id = l3.id
